findings:
The revised plan fixes all eleven blocking problems from the first review, and the numbers behind them hold up against the code: the late Cloud Descent gunship has 12.65 s to leave against the 8.72 s a faster corvette needs, its rear rockets are shut off before the section closes, the Carrier's default crossing fits between the laser-column volleys, and the weak points inside the gunship now sit on the hull's outline so shots can reach them. Of the 17 earlier findings, 16 are resolved and 1 is partly resolved (the Carrier's own rockets can still hit its own parts). What remains is ten minor points. Each changes one test row or one sentence inside one task, and the task that builds it can apply the fix with the plan sections it is given. I would approve. One is worth fixing in the plan text before the Gunship phases task starts: as written, its cannon-shield "flank shot" test cannot pass.

### 1. Cannon shield row
`EnemyShield.absorbs_hit` measures the hit's bearing from the cannon's centre (`enemy_shield.gd:155-164`). Under the flush-edge rule the cannon is reachable only through its 32 px nose edge, 12 px ahead of its centre. Every bullet arriving there sits within about 51° of the nose, inside the 120° arc, so no flank shot ever reaches the cannon.

### 2. Flush tolerance
A player bullet moves 15 px per physics step (`bullet.gd:29`, 900 px/s). A part set 2 px inside the outline is missed on about 2 of every 15 edge shots. A part 2 px proud is hit without the hull. One deterministic shot may expose neither case.

### 3. Carrier self-hits
The `EnemyRocket` HitBox mask is 128 | 512 (§1.3), so the Carrier's pursuit rockets from the dorsal bank can hit its own parts. Only §2.5 acknowledges self-hits.

### 4. Laser wall timing in the replay
The rays in `laser_wall.tscn` auto-start at level load with a 3.0 s warning and 4.0 s active time. The deep_space slice starts at 2.5 s (3.5 − `PRE_ROLL`). Instantiating the wall at slice start shifts its lethal window by 2.5 s, which can hide a real kill.

### 5. Rocket boundary
Row (b) needs −13.2 + 9 + exit + 6 + 0.5 ≥ 10, which holds only when the exit is at least 7.7 s. The heavy's 300 px/s exit may be shorter than that.

### 6. Carrier numbers
- Animation length is the sum of frame durations divided by speed: 0.56 s and 0.84 s, not 1.4 s. The literal formula leaves 0.2 s of slack where the real figure is 1.6 s.
- `acceleration` 40 from rest adds about 1.1 s to the 20.6 s worst-case life: about 86.7 s, still before the 98 s column set.
- A second EMP cannot happen in level 1, because the EMP Blast has a 15 s cooldown.

### 7. Hull share
- The beam burns a part whose centre is within 12 px of its line (`beam_behavior.gd:85-97`). Gunship parts have `hull_share` 0, so beaming a part never touches the hull.
- A Support Ship's `EnemyShield` on the root absorbs only at the root, so the flush part behind it still takes the shot.

### 8. Old-gunship reference check
t4's acceptance criterion would match enemy-roster.md, ENEMY.md and the other docs that t13 rewrites.

### 9. Door and core textures
§2.8 and §2.10 don't say where these textures live. The widened walk covers Texture2D node properties, not the root's `config` `.tres`.

### 10. Deep-space attack budget
The heavy spawns at design y −500 (world about −640). It is about 830 px from its 420 px range point, at 140 px/s and 120 px/s². It then has to turn about 10° and charge for 0.4 s, all inside 9 s.

The full evidence, including the resolution table for all 17 round-1 findings, is in the round-2 section of the review document.
